name: autoexec_combop_param_matrix
label: Matrix of Tool Parameter References for Combined Tools
description: The reference matrix for combining tool parameters can be used for automated queries and reporting scenarios.

fields.name: combop_id
fields.description: Pipeline ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Parameter name, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: matrix_uuid
fields.description: Matrix UUID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the combop_id, key fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_matrix_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the matrix_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
